scope: Offline covariance-report calibration on cached DEV estimates only. No physics, renderer, RGB model call, old test access, or online truth correction. Original motion plan and rejection remain unchanged.
point_estimator: b0 VIS3 a1; preserve all position/yaw estimates and particle dynamics
independence: VISW is one previously inspected dev episode sharing seed942 with teacher dev, not an independent validation. Validation945/946/947 has already been seen in motion work; held out from fitting, not a new test. Frames are temporally correlated; no frame-iid significance claims.
observations: Teacher baseline measured flag reconstructs last-applied-scan time; VISW own report.last_valid_obs.t provides it. Own issued command history determines load and arm settling; same-time frame before command. Reject input/report state or timestamp mismatches.
state_definition: own inferred load x own command arm/pan settle predicate from selected_config_v3; never actual contact, task phase, elapsed episode window, GT pose or observed error

variants.u1: one positive global variance multiplier a; no stale envelope
variants.u2: per-state a*raw_trace_xy+b+q*scan_age; if no newer applied scan, max with previous reported variance+q*dt (preserved across state changes); yaw unchanged

fit_rule.targets: GT squared XY error, fit DEV only, vision estimates only; oracle uses same frozen coefficients and is diagnostic
fit_rule.weight: each of the seven fitting sequences has total weight 1/7; conditional objectives renormalize those weights without duplicating frames
fit_rule.u2_stage1: independently for each state choose (a,b) minimizing weighted isotropic 2D Gaussian NLL on all fitting frames of that state; no observation-age term in stage1; <100 frames uses u1 with b=0
fit_rule.u2_stage2: freeze stage1 then jointly search q for four states, evaluating the identical causal stale-envelope recurrence used at runtime on complete fitting sequences; minimize episode-balanced NLL
fit_rule.tie: lower objective then lower a,b in stage1; lexicographic q vector in states order in stage2
fit_rule.no_adaptation: One finite comparison. No extra variants, grid extensions, window-specific coefficients, yaw retuning or validation refitting after results. New changes require another pre-run plan.

metrics.legacy_proxy: NEES_iso=2*error_xy_norm^2/sigma_xy^2; NLL_iso=log(pi*sigma_xy^2)+error_xy_norm^2/sigma_xy^2; radial coverage(p): error<=sigma*sqrt(-log(1-p)). Isotropy assumption, not exact NEES.
metrics.exact_future: log full raw/reported 3x3 covariance; exact XY NEES=e_xy^T Pxy^-1 e_xy when covariance is available; no invented off-diagonal entries for old records

selection.cohort: validation teacher vision, pooled frames for coverage/tail and equal-episode mean NLL
selection.requirements: NLL improves >=0.05 nats; pooled 95% radial coverage in [0.90,0.99]; >3sigma fraction<=0.01; each validation episode NLL does not worsen by >0.10 nats; oracle validation episode-balanced NLL does not worsen by >0.10; all point estimates bitwise unchanged
selection.rank: minimum validation equal-episode NLL, tie u1 before u2; if neither eligible keep u0, leave candidates default OFF
selection.no_gate_relaxation: A smaller reported sigma is not delivery success; no gate threshold change. Calibration-only eligibility cannot override VIS4 motion NO_GO.

execution.offline_lock_exception: explicit coordinator/user authorization applies to this entire task
execution.source_freeze: hash plan/runtime/analysis/input files before finite comparison; verify after
